title: Rotate List
statement_short: Given the head of a linked list, rotate the list to the right by k places. Return the modified linked list after performing the rotation.
hint: Large k up to 2 \* 10^9 requires modulo operation k % length, connecting tail to head into a ring before splitting.
keywords: rotate the list to the right
why_not: Right: Two Pointers connects the tail to head to measure list length, then breaks the ring at (length - k % length) in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not Math / Geometry: Modulo math calculates the effective shift, but pointer manipulation rewires the actual list structure. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Mapping node indices in an array or map uses O(n) extra memory. Not 1D DP: Dynamic programming state caching does not apply to cyclic node pointer shifts.
